function.name: set_mood
function.description: Call when Nina has shared how she is feeling (mood_check). Empathize in speech first, then call this to advance the app to music choice.

moodSummary.description: Brief summary of how Nina said she feels, in her words.

function.name: show_ai_song_pick
function.description: Call when Nina wants you (Eden) to pick a song for her. Shows a song recommendation screen.

function.name: show_favorites
function.description: Call when Nina wants to choose from her favorite songs list.

function.name: confirm_offered_song
function.description: Call when Nina agrees to sing the song currently shown on the offer screen.

function.name: pick_another_song
function.description: Call when Nina wants a different AI song suggestion (stay on offer screen).

function.name: select_favorite_song
function.description: Call when Nina picks a song from her favorites list by title or position.

listIndex.description: 1-based position in the favorites list (first song = 1).

function.name: go_back_to_music_choice
function.description: Call when Nina wants to go back, start over, or choose differently from offer, favorites, or player.

function.name: complete_song_feedback
function.description: Call after Nina shares how she liked the song (song_feedback phase).

function.name: want_another_song
function.description: Call when Nina wants to sing another song (continue_or_end phase).

function.name: done_for_today
function.description: Call when Nina is done for today (continue_or_end phase).

function.name: complete_wrap_up
function.description: Call after Nina answers whether her mood improved (wrap_up phase). Then say goodbye warmly.

improvement.description: a little | a lot | not at all | paraphrase of her answer
